001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.abilities.ai;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.econ.MarketAPI;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.rules.MemoryAPI;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.characters.AbilityPlugin;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.events.BaseEventPlugin.MarketFilter;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Abilities;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.MemFlags;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.intel.misc.SupportFleetIntel;
012import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.IntervalUtil;
013import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Misc;
014
015public class TransponderAbilityAI extends BaseAbilityAI {
016
017        private IntervalUtil interval = new IntervalUtil(0.05f, 0.15f);
018
019//      public TransponderAbilityAI(AbilityPlugin ability, ModularFleetAIAPI ai) {
020//              super(ability, ai);
021//      }
022
023        public void advance(float days) {
024                interval.advance(days * EmergencyBurnAbilityAI.AI_FREQUENCY_MULT);
025                if (!interval.intervalElapsed()) return;
026                
027                MemoryAPI mem = fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate();
028                
029                boolean playerSupportFleet = Misc.isPlayerSupportFleet(fleet) && 
030                                fleet.getMemoryWithoutUpdate().getBoolean(SupportFleetIntel.SUPPORT_FLEET_FOLLOW);
031                if (playerSupportFleet && fleet.isInCurrentLocation()) {
032                        CampaignFleetAPI player = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
033                        //float dist = Misc.getDistance(player, fleet);
034                        AbilityPlugin sb = player.getAbility(Abilities.TRANSPONDER);
035                        if (sb != null) {
036                                if (sb.isActive()) {
037                                        if (!ability.isActive()) ability.activate();
038                                } else if (!sb.isActive()) {
039                                        if (ability.isActive()) ability.deactivate();
040                                }
041                        }
042                        return;
043                }
044                
045//              if (fleet.isInCurrentLocation()) {
046//                      float dist = Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocation());
047//                      if (dist < fleet.getRadius() + Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getRadius() + 10f) {
048//                              System.out.println("sdfsdfdsXX1e12");
049//                      }
050//              }
051                
052//              if (ability.isActive()) {
053//                      return;
054//              }
055                
056                boolean smuggler = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_SMUGGLER);
057                boolean pirate = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PIRATE);
058                boolean patrol = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_PATROL_FLEET);
059                //patrol |= mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_WAR_FLEET);
060                
061                boolean trader = mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_TRADE_FLEET);
062                
063                if (smuggler || pirate || mem.getBoolean(MemFlags.MEMORY_KEY_FORCE_TRANSPONDER_OFF)) {
064                        if (ability.isActive()) {
065                                ability.deactivate();
066                        }
067                        return;
068                }
069                
070                if (patrol || trader) {
071                        if (!ability.isActive()) {
072                                ability.activate();
073                        }
074                        return;
075                }
076                
077//              if (fleet.getName().contains("Scavenger") && 
078//                              Misc.getDistance(fleet.getLocation(), Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet().getLocation()) < 1000f) {
079//                      System.out.println("wefwefewf");
080//              }
081                
082                if (fleet.isInHyperspace()) {
083                        float nonHostileSize = 0;
084                        float hostileSize = 0;
085                        for (MarketAPI market : Misc.getNearbyMarkets(fleet.getLocation(), 1f)) {
086                                float size = market.getSize();
087                                if (market.getFaction().isHostileTo(fleet.getFaction())) {
088                                        hostileSize += size;
089                                } else {
090                                        nonHostileSize += size;
091                                }
092                        }
093                        
094                        if (nonHostileSize > hostileSize) {
095                                if (!ability.isActive()) {
096                                //if (!fleet.isTransponderOn()) {
097                                        ability.activate();
098                                }
099                        } else {
100                                if (ability.isActive()) {
101                                //if (fleet.isTransponderOn()) {
102                                        ability.deactivate();
103                                }
104                        }
105                        return;
106                }
107                
108                MarketAPI nearestMarket = Misc.findNearestLocalMarket(fleet, 1000000, new MarketFilter() {
109                        public boolean acceptMarket(MarketAPI market) {
110                                return true;
111                        }
112                });
113
114                if (nearestMarket != null) {
115                        if (nearestMarket.getFaction().isHostileTo(fleet.getFaction())) {
116                                if (ability.isActive()) {
117                                        ability.deactivate();
118                                }
119                        } else {
120                                if (!ability.isActive()) {
121                                        ability.activate();
122                                }
123                        }
124                        return;
125                } else {
126//                      if (!ability.isActive()) {
127//                              ability.activate();
128//                      }
129                        if (ability.isActive()) {
130                                ability.deactivate();
131                        }
132                        return;
133                }
134        }
135}
